counterfactual_missing_items: hydroxychloroquine 200 mg daily for 18 months before presentation
Toluidine blue-stained sections: scattered vacuolated fibers
Ultrastructural examination showed increased mitochondria, membranous profiles, lysosomes, and lipid vacuoles
response.rationale: R4 best links the SLE/lupus nephritis cause to the dilated LV and reduced EF phenotype. R1 explains ESKD but omits EF and SLE; R3 explains hypertension but is weakened by normal wall thickness and omits SLE/ESKD. All candidates miss the HCQ exposure and vacuolar/lysosomal biopsy findings, which are the true decisive evidence for hydroxychloroquine-induced cardiomyopathy.

rejected.why: Hypertension and reduced EF are present, but normal wall thickness and the vacuolar/lysosomal biopsy are not characteristic; it omits SLE, ESKD, and HCQ exposure.
